title: Battle target policies for Staunch Defender and Dark Spirit of the Silent
scope: Isolated TagDuel 2v2 adapter. The adapter rewrites the pending attack declaration or stores a turn-scoped forced-target policy; it does not execute battle damage or replace the central battle resolver.

cards.name: Staunch Defender
cards.effect: Activate only when the opponent declares an attack; choose one face-up monster you control. For the rest of that turn, the opponent can only designate that monster as an attack target and must attack it with all face-up monsters.

cards.name: Dark Spirit of the Silent
cards.effect: When an opponent's monster declares an attack, negate that attack and select another face-up monster your opponent controls; that monster attacks instead, changing from face-up Defense to Attack if needed.

fixturePolicy: Tests use already-enabled Trap IDs as physical fixtures and a test-only lookup to exercise these effects. The two historical card IDs above remain absent from the enabled registry.
limitations: A caller must connect the adapter to the response window for Pending attack stage declare.
The central battle resolver must consume the rewritten pending attacker/target and invoke the forced-target policy for subsequent attacks.
Damage calculation, destruction, battle triggers and attack counters remain owned by the central resolver.
